item.title: [Westminster City Council] Consent Item Pulled: Pass Councillor's Bill No. 56 on second reading authorizing the City Manager to execute an EDA with the Butterﬂy Pavilion to provide up to $250,000 in reimbursement support for approved pre-development activities associated with the proposed expansion and renovation of the Butterfly Pavilion campus (Tabled 6-1)
